clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers and traders crowd the Commons, just inside Ironforge's gates. The district links the entrance to the mountain city's great caverns and draws merchants, travelers, and bankers from across the Alliance.

The Commons greets you just northeast of the Gates of Ironforge. Carved from the mountain stone, its market street holds the Alliance Auction House, Stonefire Tavern, and the city's central bank in the Vault of Ironforge. Broad roads lead from here to the Great Forge, the Mystic Ward, and the Military Ward. Nearly everyone crossing the mountain city passes its shops.

The Commons draws trade from across the Eastern Kingdoms. Ironforge's central position and the underground Deeprun Tram link to Stormwind bring travelers and merchants here. Adventurers trade goods from across Azeroth, buy weapons at Steelfury's Weapon Emporium, or purchase reagents from Barim. Some meet beneath the inn's warm lanterns before setting out into the snows of Khaz Modan.
